inputs.label: The House of the Dead 2 Dreamcast disc dump
inputs.help: Your own dump of the Dreamcast game as .chd, .gdi with its track files, .cue with its .bin files, or .cdi. Unpack a .zip or .7z first. Tested with the European release (MK-5100250). The US release (MK-51002) is also supported.

steps.why: The setup panel searches Download for the game. The guide has the user allow All files access.

steps.text: Open HOTD2 VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for All files access, allow it. The first start plays the game by itself for a minute or two to make the hands and pistol. Press B to skip this.

notes: Releases are all pre-releases (test builds). They also carry hotd2-vr-pcvr.zip. GDI dumps can have .raw tracks; the guide names only .bin, so .raw is not accepted yet. The same APK also plays The Maze of the Kings (mok.zip, naomi.zip and mok/gds-0022.chd in Download); that game has its own entry, mok-vr, so it is left out here.
